column6: Producer's own tasting notes describe "chocolatey" palate with "caramel"/pastry sweetness across the Extra Collection range (rum-cask finished)
Producer's own site: "gourmand...chocolatey in the mouth" for the Extra Collection range
Producer's own site describes every expression with vanilla notes (vanilla sponge cake, baking spice) alongside oak.
Producer's own site: "fresh, creamy and fruity" house style, dried fruit/light fruits across expressions.

Producer's own site: the Single Malt Whisky is described as entirely matured in sherry casks -- a structural production claim, not just a tasting-note adjective. Scoped to baseline rather than require since the same range also includes a Single Rye Whisky whose cask treatment is not stated.

Signature: "Vanilla mousse with candied zest ... on the nose." Grain: "rounded with decadent oak vanillin." Consistent across two of the three current products.
Signature: "light oak shavings on the nose." Grain: "decadent oak vanillin." Both current products name oak explicitly.
Finished six months in first-fill oloroso sherry butts per scotchwhisky.com.
Cedar-cask-derived smoke note (Demon Knight: "cedar smoke" finish; Deadly Sakura: "light smoky close"), not peat -- producer's own copy attributes it to cask aging.

Arran's own site lists vanilla among the Robert Burns Blend's flavour notes.

scotchwhisky.com: the west-coast Island malt component gives a salty edge alongside the smoky finish.
A.D. Rattray's own tasting notes: "soft honey, earthy heather" (nose), "luscious honey and biscuits" (palate).

Nikka's own site: "a sweet, slightly bitter dark chocolate finish."
Producer's own site describes it as "a light coloured, soft whisky with elegant overtones of fruitiness."
Same page: "pleasant hints of vanilla and pear drops."
Woodsmoke character is explicitly from double-scorched ex-bourbon casks, not peated malt, per the producer's own product description quoted in this article.
Official tasting description states "a hint of smokiness" from double-charred oak casks, not from peat.
